visual.general_description: Line chart with four colored series plotted against clock times, with a shaded region labelled HEMODIALYSIS.
visual.detailed_description: White-background line chart with light horizontal gridlines and circular markers at ten x positions labelled 14:00, 17:00, 19:00, 21:00, 21:45D, 23:45D, 2:00D, 3:20D, 4:45D and 5:50D, with the red axis title TIME beneath. The left vertical axis shows ticks 0 to 40 in steps of 5 without an axis title; the right vertical axis, titled pH in orange, shows ticks from 6.9 to 7.45 in steps of 0.05. Colored text at the upper left reads Lactate (mmol/L) in blue, PCO2 (mmHg) in gray and HCO3 (mmol/L) in yellow; the words Lactate (blue) and HCO3 (yellow) also appear inside the plot. A pale blue rectangle spans from the 21:45D position to the 5:50D position, with red text HEMODIALYSIS at its top. The blue line rises from the first marker to a maximum at the 21:45D position, then falls to its lowest point at 5:50D. The orange line falls from the first marker to the 21:45D position, then rises to a plateau near the top of the pH axis. The gray line is lowest at 21:00 and 21:45D and then rises. The yellow line declines to a flat stretch through 23:45D, then rises. No numeric data labels are printed at the markers.
